body.description: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean outline, detailed shading. One item only, it fills most of the square, transparent background. Each item stays fully inside its own square and does not touch the edges. No pedestal, no stand, no display base, no plate, no text, no letters, no numbers, no extra objects.
item_descriptions: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean dark outline around the whole object, detailed shading. an eye-only half mask, front view, wide and flat: the top edge sweeps outward into two pointed tips at the far left and right, the bottom edge cuts up into a deep V notch at the center where the nose goes, two narrow almond-shaped eye holes slanting slightly upward, smooth hard lacquered shell, sleek and elegant. Not an animal head: no ears, no horns, no snout, no beak sticking out. The animal is only hinted at by a stylized shape of the edge and a faint engraved pattern. Deep navy-black glossy surface, and the whole edge of the mask is finished with a raised polished gold trim band 2 to 3 pixels wide, the gold band is part of the mask, the body inside the trim stays navy-black, not a gold mask. Mallard hint: the lower center between the eyes is a soft rounded curve instead of a sharp notch, faint fine feather lines engraved in gold on the cheeks. Only this item, nothing else beside it, no text, no halo or glow outside the object's outline, fully inside its square.
